title: Denver Breakfast Casserole
subtitle: Ham, bell peppers, and onion baked into a make-ahead egg strata.
description: Ham, bell peppers, onion, and cheddar baked with eggs — the Denver omelette in casserole form for ten hungry firefighters.

steps.title: Toast the bread cubes
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 350°F. Spread bread cubes on a sheet pan and toast 6–8 minutes until dry at the edges. Cool slightly so they don't turn the custard soggy.

steps.title: Build the pan
steps.instruction: Butter a deep 9x13 dish. Layer half the bread, ham, peppers, onion, and half the cheese. Repeat layers, finishing with cheese on top.

steps.title: Whisk the custard
steps.instruction: Whisk eggs with milk, dry mustard, salt, pepper, and a pinch of paprika until smooth. Pour evenly over the bread—press gently so cubes soak without compacting.

steps.title: Rest or refrigerate
steps.instruction: Rest 30 minutes at room temperature, or cover and refrigerate overnight for a true make-ahead. Bring closer to room temp before baking if chilled.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.instruction: Bake at 375°F until puffed, golden at the edges, and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Rest 10 minutes before cutting into squares for the line.

stationWorkflow: Prep and refrigerate the casserole the night before a busy shift; pull it 30 minutes before baking.
Assign one cook to oven checks while another sets up a warm holding pan with foil for staggered eaters.
Cut with a sharp serrated knife in the pan, then lift squares with a offset spatula to keep layers intact.
cleanupNotes: Soak the 9x13 in warm soapy water immediately after serving—egg custard bonds to metal if left to dry.
Line the sheet pan with parchment when toasting bread cubes for a one-wipe cleanup.
leftovers: Wrap individual squares in foil and reheat at 325°F for 12 minutes until steaming in the center.
Dice cold casserole into a breakfast fried rice with soy, green onion, and a fried egg on top.
imageAlt: Golden Denver breakfast casserole squares with ham and bell peppers

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free bun/bread and toast on a separate, clean surface.

adaptable.label: Dairy-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use oat, almond, or soy milk (check tree-nut/soy status of the substitute). Use a dairy-free cheese shred/block alternative.
